cpos.reason: GOLDBECK publicly confirms German EV charging products, consumption-based billing and no monthly fee, but the public charging pages and customer-account entry points do not expose a reproducible current German per-kWh price for a specific station/EVSE. Public web searches for DE*GOL expose station identities and roaming/eMSP values, but no verifiable current physical CPO price. Austrian GOLDBECK prices and eMSP/roaming tariffs are explicitly excluded from German CPO pricing. After official site, public account/charging pages, station-level discovery and public web/aggregator checks, no exact German station/EVSE price is safely attachable.
cpos.unblockRequires: A public GOLDBECK Mobility/direct-payment payload, tariff page, receipt/example, or other reproducible source exposing the exact current German charging price for a DE*GOL station/EVSE.

cpos.reason: Current APCOA Germany pages confirm charging locations and ad-hoc QR/direct-payment capability at multiple sites, but do not expose a reproducible current charging price in public HTML. A previously recorded 0.45 EUR/kWh Neumarkt Leipzig value is no longer present on the current official page and has been fail-closed rather than retained as stale evidence. Public station directories confirm APCOA ownership and DE*ACO EVSE identities at other German sites, while their ad-hoc price remains unknown. eMSP/roaming prices and foreign APCOA tariffs are not used as CPO prices.
cpos.unblockRequires: A reproducible APCOA QR/direct-payment endpoint or official station tariff exposing the exact current price for a DE*ACO EVSE/station, or a new official APCOA German tariff explicitly scoped to its physical charging network.
